query: TSMC ADR stock price valuation analyst targets
normalized: adr analyst price stock targets tsmc valuation

output.content:
**TSMC ADR (NYSE: TSM) snapshot — 16 October 2026:** the ADR was quoted at **$412.25 after the close** (the regular-session close was **$412.61**), following a **2.28%** daily decline; its trailing P/E was **25.44x** and price-to-sales ratio **13.20x**. [[1]]

**Street targets:** the S&P Global-based consensus comprised **21 analysts**, rated **“Strong Buy,”** with a mean 12‑month target of **$584.39**, implying **41.6% upside** from the contemporaneous price; the published range was **$440 to $1,000**, with a **$557.50 median**. [[2]]

**Recent named targets:** Needham raised its target to **$560** from **$530** on 15 October while retaining Buy; BofA’s cited target was **$620**, Barclays’ was **$665**, and TD Cowen’s **$440 Hold** target represents the lower end of the disclosed range. [[3]] [[4]] [[3]]

**Valuation:** S&P Global data put TSMC at **17.49x forward P/E** in Q3 2026, down from **18.85x** in Q2, versus a **25.44x trailing P/E**; separately, its enterprise-value-to-next-twelve-month revenue multiple was **7.84x** as of 16–17 October. [[5]] [[6]]

**Fundamental support for the premium:** TSMC reported Q3 2026 ADR EPS of **$4.60** and US-dollar revenue of **$46.72 billion**, with revenue up **41.2% year over year** and gross margin at **66.4%**; advanced nodes of 7nm and below represented **79%** of wafer revenue. [[7]]

**Near-term catalyst:** management guided Q4 2026 revenue to **$52.3–$54.3 billion**, gross margin to **65%–67%**, and operating margin to **56.5%–58.5%**, framing the bull case around sustained leading-edge and 2nm demand. [[7]]

**Analyst view:** the consensus upside is substantial, but the valuation already relies on continued earnings growth and execution; the principal watch items are whether Q4 revenue clears the guide, whether 2nm ramp dilution keeps gross margin within the 65%–67% range, and whether strong AI/advanced-node demand persists. [[7]]
